Expectation1: Help out during difficult times or emergencies.
Situation1: You get a frantic call from your friend whose car has broken down on the side of the highway late at night, and they need you to come get them immediately.
Expectation2: Secure packages and confirm successful delivery
Situation2: Requesting a signature upon delivery for moderately valuable items
Story: My phone buzzed just as I was pulling up to the last house on my delivery route. It was late, and I was tired, but I still had one moderately valuable package left to deliver, and the customer had specifically requested a signature. As I stepped out of the van, my phone rang again—this time, it was my best friend, panicked and nearly in tears. Her car had broken down on the side of the highway, and she was alone, scared, and begging me to come get her right away. I could hear the cars rushing past her in the background. My job demanded that I secure the package and get the signature before I could leave, but my friend needed me now, not in half an hour. My heart pounded as I stood there, torn between the responsibility to my job and the desperate plea of someone I cared about.
